seo_desc: Christmas events for kids in Safford, Arizona for 2026: 5 family events, 2 free, with dates, times and addresses checked on each host's site.
lede: Safford celebrates with a Merry Main Street tree lighting, a lighted parade and holiday concerts at Eastern Arizona College in Thatcher.
celebrates: The Safford Downtown Association starts the season with Merry Main Street and the Freeport-McMoRan Tree Lighting Ceremony on the City Hall lawn, with Santa, a snow sledding hill, crafts and Christmas trains for kids. Two weeks later it presents the 29th Annual COUNTRY Financial Light Parade, Christmas in Toyland. Eastern Arizona College in neighboring Thatcher adds a Festival of Carols and a Nathan Pacheco Christmas concert. This page also carries the City of Willcox's Christmas Holiday Bazaar and Parade, since Willcox has too few events for its own page.
lastyear: The COUNTRY Financial Light Parade numbers 29 in 2026, which means last year's was the 28th annual parade in downtown Safford. The Graham County Chamber of Commerce page for the 2026 event lists a family and friends parade category and says the free celebration runs from 4 to 7 pm with Santa photos. The 2026 Merry Main Street page also notes free s'mores and a separate retro championship with no entry fee.
facts: The Safford Downtown Association says its tree lighting is presented with Freeport-McMoRan and Ponderosa Air Ambulance. The Light Parade carries the name COUNTRY Financial in 2026. In 2026 the parade's theme is Christmas in Toyland, and the route runs along Main Street from 8th Avenue to 2nd Avenue. The Graham County Chamber of Commerce publishes the event pages for both Safford celebrations.
trains: Safford does not have a passenger train, but the Merry Main Street celebration lists Christmas trains for kids as one of its activities on the City Hall lawn. For a depot visit, our site lists the Benson Visitor Center Train Depot, a replica of the original depot in the Southern Pacific railroad town of Benson, which is a drive from Graham County.
train_links: A replica of the original depot now serves as the visitor center in Benson, a Southern Pacific railroad town.

faq: When is the Safford tree lighting in 2026?

Merry Main Street and the Freeport-McMoRan Tree Lighting Ceremony are on Friday, November 27, 2026, from 5:30 to 8 pm Arizona time. The lighting and ribbon cutting are at 5:30 pm at the Safford City Hall lawn. The chamber's page lists Santa, a snow sledding hill, crafts, trains and free s'mores.
When is the Safford Christmas parade?

The 29th Annual COUNTRY Financial Light Parade, Christmas in Toyland, is Saturday, December 12, 2026. The free celebration runs from 4 to 7 pm in downtown Safford, with Santa photos from 4 to 5:45 pm, live entertainment at 5 pm and the parade at 6 pm along Main Street.
Where is the Willcox Christmas parade?

The City of Willcox holds its Christmas Holiday Bazaar and Holiday Parade at Railroad Park on North Railroad Avenue on Saturday, December 12, 2026, starting at 11 am. The city lists vendors, food, free kids activities, a rock-climbing wall and an outdoor skating rink. It sits on this page because Willcox has too few events for its own.
Are there Christmas concerts near Safford?

Yes. Eastern Arizona College in Thatcher, next to Safford, lists the EAC Festival of Carols on Tuesday, December 1, 2026, from 7 to 9 pm and tenor Nathan Pacheco's Christmas tour on Friday, December 11, from 7:30 to 9 pm. Neither calendar entry prints a ticket price, so check with the college.

We check every date on the host's own website, and each listing links straight there.
